            "weirdkey-B": "topLevelString",

        }
    },
    "Parameters": {
    },
    "Resources": {
        "Bucket": {"Type": "AWS::S3::Bucket"},
    },
}

def _make_cfn() -> Template:
    return Template("foo.yaml", _TEMPLATE, ["us-east-1"])
